data.one_liner: Library for parsing CLI input and structuring commands
data.what_it_does: Bosun parses command line arguments and flags into a structured command tree, automatically generates help text, and suggests similar commands when an invalid command is entered.
use_when: Building command line tools or scripts in Dart
Creating nested command hierarchies for CLI applications
Automating tests that involve command line parsing
avoid_when: Applications that do not require command line interaction
strengths: Automatic help generation and error suggestions
weaknesses: No built‑in support for async command execution
